notes: Mid-century block, not Victorian: tan stucco end piers with full-width ribbon glazing bands (two glazed runs) on storeys 1-2 (storeys 1 and 2) via storeyWindowSpans; central dark-brown lattice screen over the entry core (hand.py slats) with a gated entry and small red pergola canopy; flat roof, no cornice, no belt course; dark thin fascia (trim). Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. Beige piers, ground storey glazed (stair tower + ribbon), tower sills dropped to full-height glazing with a visible stair (hand.py), rectangular-grid screen over the gate, thin dark roof fascia, red-topped pipe canopy standing out at the kerb side.
